title: Ajai Alai
subtitle: Ik Achhree Chhand from Jaap Sahib — Invincible, Indestructible, Fearless, Eternal
theme: A prayer for courage, fearlessness and unshakeable strength
intention: Sing this when you need to stand firm — before a difficult conversation, an exam, a shift, a decision you cannot walk away from. Each word is a name of the One who cannot be defeated.

source.granth: Sri Dasam Granth Sahib — Jaap Sahib

keywords: Ajai Alai Abhai Abai Abhu Aju Anas Akas

verses.e: Unborn, without beginning, imperishable, all-pervading like the sky.
Unbreakable, unshatterable, unseen, needing no sustenance.
Beyond time, compassionate, beyond account, beyond any garb.
Without name, without desire, unfathomable, unassailable.
Without a master, destroyer of the mighty, beyond birth, beyond silence.

verses.g: ਨ ਰਾਗੇ ਨ ਰੰਗੇ ਨ ਰੂਪੇ ਨ ਰੇਖੇ ॥
verses.t: Na raage na range na roope na rekhe.
verses.e: Without attachment, without colour, without form, without outline.
Beyond karma, beyond doubt, indestructible, beyond all reckoning.
